# implicit-sdf.concepts: IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A planar SDF plus a conservative axis-aligned domain for culling. Bounds
> should enclose every point where distance ≤ 0 when used as a solid hint;
> for sampled lattices they span the lattice. Outside Bounds, callers may
> skip work; Eval / DistanceAt remain defined and unchanged.

## Signature

```plato
interface IBoundedSignedDistanceField2D
    inherits ISignedDistanceField2D, IBounded2D
```
